characters.description: A farmer and defender of the valley who carries a dangerous dragon spirit within his mana pool.
characters.name: John Sutton

characters.description: A spirit confined within John's mana pool that threatens to seize his body and help bring about the world's end.
characters.name: Dragon spirit

characters.description: John's farm partner, a witch, and his closest adviser.
characters.name: Ellie

characters.description: An off-world ally of John who vanished after passing through the First Mage's Door.
characters.name: Katrine

characters.description: Katrine's travelling companion, who vanished with her after they passed through the First Mage's Door.
characters.name: Togine

characters.description: A mana-sensitive farm guardian and combat ally.
characters.name: Ferdie

characters.description: Ellie's summoned lightning-bird familiar and a trusted scout among the farm's defenders.
characters.name: Sigvald

characters.description: John's farm lieutenant and a defender of the valley.
characters.name: Thomas

characters.description: A returning member of the farm community who is away when John begins the search for Katrine.
characters.name: Ben

characters.description: A tower-bound plant mage who supports the farm community's magical and agricultural work.
characters.name: Shadow Tower plant mage

characters.description: A powerful seer who oversees the Arcane Tower. She takes charge of John's outworlder registration after noticing the unusual purity of his mana.
characters.name: Arcane Tower master

characters.description: A nervous Fourth Order resident of Candle Scholar Tower who befriends John and becomes his informal guide to tower society.
characters.name: Fourth Order tower guide

characters.description: The administrative spirit that manages registrations, member records, and information requests within Candle Scholar Tower.
characters.name: Candle Scholar Tower spirit

characters.description: A Ninth Order mage who evaluates John's skill by assigning an Eighth Order duplication spell. Impressed by the result, he seeks to recruit John as his direct student.
characters.name: Wind Tower master

characters.description: The organizer of Katrine's sealed artifact expedition, this Eighth Order Wind Tower researcher departs by gate before questions begin. His actions place him under primary suspicion for her disappearance.
characters.name: Wind Tower artifact researcher

characters.description: A tower master whose aura halts a confrontation between John and the Wind Tower master during John's assessment.
characters.name: Light Tower master

characters.description: A supreme Ninth Order mage who leads the Cabal of the Broken Gate and approaches the hypothetical Tenth Order. Candle Scholar Tower considers his organization too dangerous to confront directly.
characters.name: Cabal supreme mage

characters.description: An armored Cabal buyer who purchases John's fabricated captive, takes custody of John in that disguise, and says the Cabal has already sent advance forces into John's world.
characters.name: Cabal buyer

characters.description: The title used by the armored Cabal buyer who brings John through a temporary gate and explains that enslaved mages are used in lethal experiments.
characters.name: The Merciful

characters.description: A Cabal operative who attacks John while concealed by enchanted bracers.
characters.name: Cabal shadow guard

characters.description: A legendary tamer who commands the northern mountain wolf packs and guides John and Thomas while they investigate beasts gathering near the valley.
characters.name: Wolf king

characters.description: A sage-level bear who serves as a Beast Army general. He confronts John, Thomas, and the wolf king in the northern mountains and demands their submission to the beast ruler.
characters.name: Bear general

characters.description: The mage identified as the builder of Shadow Tower.
characters.name: Storm Master Kelvis

characters.description: The nature spirit bound to Shadow Tower, whose purpose is safeguarding learning and advancing magical study.
characters.name: Shadow Tower nature spirit

characters.description: The Beast Army's seventh general, also called the Reaper of the Dark Woods. He arrives near the farm with the sage bear to challenge John and represents the stronger force gathering against the valley as its defenders prepare for war.
characters.name: Markov

characters.description: A long-lived sage mage who leads New Dawn from underground laboratories. He offers John an alliance and acknowledges that his organization supported the Iron Monarch's device, while presenting unity among humans as his goal.
characters.name: The Undying

characters.description: A scale-covered ruler and destroyer of the Beast Army who confronts John after two generals die. She claims descent from an immortal dragon and a fox, displays power beyond the sages John has faced, and demands that he marry her.
characters.name: Gora

characters.description: The ancient spirit of Gora's palace tower. It recognizes the first mage as its master, regards the Beast Army's occupation as hostile, and agrees to covertly reroute mana to John.
characters.name: Palace tower spirit

characters.description: A former human acquaintance of Gora who is imprisoned beneath her palace. Drinking the heart blood of Gora's eight-tailed mother gave him unusual longevity and strength.
characters.name: Felix

characters.description: A Beast Army general who releases John from captivity and brings him before Gora and her generals to prove his worth as her prospective mate.
characters.name: Monkey-beast general

aliases: Lady Orateth of the Dark Path
characters.description: A curse specialist and sage of Soaring Cloud Tower. She joins the emergency defense when released legendary beasts attack after Ellie's warning about the hidden invasion portal, working beside the tower's flame sage against the immediate threat.
characters.name: Orateth
